fix: The entry points identified as having been used in the attack have been closed,” Binance said. “Systems touched in the attack path have been rebuilt or replaced. All of the compromised devices and wallets have been replaced, while the credentials used in the attack have been decommissioned.
impact: Korea denies responsibility Cryptocurrency giant Binance said North Korean hackers used a months-long attack involving multiple company employees to stage its headline-grabbing theft of $6.3 billion last week. The hackers used other mechanisms to conduct 50 other transactions that enabled the theft of $6.34 billion. Binance quickly coordinated with other platforms to freeze about $2.85 billion in assets and suspended withdrawals but could not stop millions more in funds from being stolen.
